svg.title: Production deployment: clients go through a CDN and load balancer with TLS to several container replicas running uvicorn workers; replicas use PostgreSQL via a pooler, Redis for cache and rate limits, a queue with separate workers, and send telemetry to monitoring

svg.text: Stateless API replicas; state lives in PostgreSQL, Redis and the queue.
